test.title: Section 1 · a theatre and dog care

topic.en: Two everyday texts: booking rules at a theatre, and three dog-care services.
topic.kk: Екі тұрмыстық мәтін: театрда билет брондау ережесі және итке күтім жасайтын үш қызмет.
topic.ru: Два бытовых текста: правила бронирования в театре и три службы по уходу за собаками.

paragraphs.text: Westfield Theatre — booking information. The box office is open from 10 am to 6 pm, Monday to Saturday, and until the start of the performance on show days. Tickets can also be booked online at no extra cost or by telephone, although a charge of £1.50 is added to each telephone booking. Tickets for the Christmas show go on sale on 1 September and usually sell out within a few weeks, so early booking is advised.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Seats in the stalls are closest to the stage, while the circle, upstairs, gives the best view of dance performances. Four wheelchair spaces are available in the stalls and must be booked by telephone, and a companion seat next to each space is free. For some performances a signed or captioned version is offered, and these are marked in the programme with a symbol.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Tickets cannot be refunded, but they can be exchanged for another performance of the same show up to forty-eight hours before the original date, for a fee of £2 per ticket. Latecomers will be admitted only at a suitable break in the performance, which may be up to twenty minutes after the start. Children under three are not admitted, except to the special relaxed performances held on Saturday mornings.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: Paws on the Park. Group walks of up to six dogs, twice a day, on weekdays only. Every walker holds a first-aid certificate for animals, and dogs are collected from and returned to your home. Before the first walk, we meet you and your dog at home at no charge, to check that your dog is comfortable with other dogs. Walks are paid for monthly in advance.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Ashby Dog Hotel. Overnight boarding in heated indoor kennels with an outdoor run, for anything from one night to four weeks. Dogs must be up to date with their vaccinations, and owners are asked to bring the dog’s usual food to avoid stomach upsets. Visitors are welcome to look round by appointment, and a daily photograph of your dog can be sent by text message.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Home from Home. Instead of going into kennels, your dog stays in the house of one of our carers, who look after no more than two dogs at a time. We try to match each dog with a carer who has a similar pet. Short-notice bookings are accepted whenever a carer is available, and a trial day, charged at half price, is recommended before a longer stay.
paragraphs.label: C

Tickets for the relaxed performances cost less than tickets for other shows.
